components.name: proposition
values: sci-plex can distinguish cell-type-specific and shared transcriptional responses to compounds as exemplified by the distinct response of mek inhibitor trametinib in mcf7 versus a549 and k562 cells.

components.name: proposition
values: nuclear hashing using unmodified ssdna oligos stably labels nuclei and is compatible with sci-rna-seq enabling single-cell transcriptomic profiling of many samples in a single experiment.

components.name: proposition
values: sci-plex enables high-throughput chemical screens at single-cell resolution profiling 650 000 cells across 5000 conditions in a single experiment.

components.name: proposition
values: sci-plex can identify compounds that target convergent pathways by comparing single-cell transcriptional responses as evidenced by the similarity between mek and hsp90 inhibitor signatures.

components.name: proposition
values: hdac inhibitor dose governs the magnitude rather than the rate of cellular response and heterogeneity in response cannot be solely attributed to asynchrony.

components.name: proposition
values: the global transcriptional response to hdac inhibitors is consistent with induction of an acetyl-coa-deprived state as supported by upregulation of acetyl-coa synthesis enzymes and blocking of the response by acetyl-coa precursors.

components.name: proposition
values: sci-plex can quantify dose-dependent transcriptional responses to multiple compounds and infer viability scores concordant with gold standard measurements.

components.name: method
values: dose-response modeling of gene expression | generalized linear regression was used to model each gene s expression as a function of dose. differentially expressed genes were identified. viability score inferred from cell counts post-treatment.

sci-plex workflow for chemical screens | cells were exposed to compounds in multiwell plates then lysed to expose nuclei. nuclei were hashed with well-specific hash oligos and fixed. pooled nuclei were subjected to sci-rna-seq for single-cell transcriptomic profiling.

components.name: name
values: pilot chemical screen with sci-plex on a549 cells

components.name: result_metric
values: number of genes sensitive to at least one drug

components.name: task
values: exposed a549 cells to dexamethasone nutlin-3a bms-345541 or vorinostat saha for 24 hours across seven doses in triplicate 84 drug-dose-replicate combinations plus vehicle controls .
inferred viability score from recovered cellular counts and compared to gold standard measurements.
labeled nuclei from each well and performed sci-rna-seq2.
used monocle 3 for umap visualization and louvain clustering modeled gene expression as a function of dose via generalized linear regression.

components.name: method
values: nuclear hashing with ssdna oligos | cells are lysed to expose nuclei in the presence of well-specific polyadenylated ssdna hash oligos fixed with paraformaldehyde pooled and subjected to sci-rna-seq. hash oligos are combinatorially indexed alongside endogenous mrnas.
statistical framework for hash assignment | a statistical framework was devised to identify the hash oligos associated with each cell at a frequency exceeding background table s1 .

components.name: name
values: nuclear hashing method development and validation

components.name: result_metric
values: concordance between hash-based and transcriptome-based species assignment

components.name: task
values: developed nuclear hashing using unmodified single-stranded dna oligos to label nuclei in a multiwell format compatible with sci-rna-seq.
evaluated hash stability to freeze-thaw cycle and doublet detection by varying nuclei loading per pcr well predicted collision rates 7-23% .

performed barnyard experiment with human hek293t and mouse nih3t3 cells in 48 wells each labeled with a well-specific polyadenylated ssdna hash oligo then pooled and processed via two-level sci-rna-seq.

components.name: dataset
values: hdac inhibitor trajectory and metabolite perturbation dataset

components.name: method
values: acetyl-coa modulation experiment | a549 and mcf7 cells were treated with pracinostat in the presence or absence of acetyl-coa precursors acetate pyruvate citrate or inhibitors of acly acss2 or pdh. cells were harvested and processed with sci-plex for trajectory analysis.

consensus pseudodose trajectory construction | hdac inhibitor-treated and vehicle cells from three cell lines were aligned using a mutual-nearest neighbor mnn matching approach to produce a consensus hdac inhibitor trajectory termed pseudodose.

components.name: task
values: aligned hdac inhibitor-treated cells from three cell lines using mutual-nearest neighbor matching to produce a consensus pseudodose trajectory.
measured acetylated lysine levels after hdac inhibitor treatment.
performed 72-hour time course with 48 compounds on a549 cells to assess asynchrony.
performed differential expression analysis along pseudodose identified cell-cycle arrest and metabolic gene changes.
tested effect of acetyl-coa precursor supplementation acetate pyruvate citrate and enzyme inhibition acly acss2 pdh on hdac inhibitor response in a549 and mcf7 cells.
